## Dan's GUI HUD Pack

Custom retexture for crosshair, hearts, hunger, armor, XP bar, air bubbles, potion effects & other effects on hearts, and the mount/jump bar. Clean, consistent HUD overhaul — no mods needed.

**Built for:** Minecraft 1.20.1 (may work on nearby versions, though not guaranteed)

![HUD](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/34bf9cd9fc4dbb6d8c4d2d3674e41c2e822c703b_0.webp)
